description: Report radio link quality (RSSI, in dBm) for every device, resolved to device names, plus BidCos interface health (duty cycle, connected state). Covers both transports: BidCos-RF via Interface.rssiInfo, and HmIP-RF via each device's RSSI_DEVICE/RSSI_PEER maintenance datapoints. Use to answer 'why is this sensor flaky?'. Higher (closer to 0) dBm is better; null = no measurement.

name.description: Filter by device name or address (substring, case-insensitive)

name: get_rssi

devices.description: Per device: {address, name, interface, links:[{peer, rssiDevice, rssiPeer}]}
